items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I remember Katherine Dunham throwing her arms around me and saying - when you're out of all this - come back -- you'll have a job with me

ctx.x: And, you do the same - but it's still the jazz because you're doing your improvising on those so-called pretty ballads--

Yes. Well, we were a great success with the Katherine Dunham Show and when that show closed, we went from there to another theater; see, her contract ran out in that theater and, then, we went to the--- another theater that was on - was it 48th or 49th-- I can't just remember the theater----

items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: you know what a Russian dancer is ---

ctx.x: Well, he was older but I mean, I think maybe he was only six or eight years older--

Yeah but he was an absolutely sensational dancer; he could sing; he could play cello ; bass saxophone; flute; clarinet, and he get all these little tricks - you know - and he was a -- you know what a Russian dancer is ---
